ai_summary: Adroit Industries reported robust Q1 FY27 PAT growth of 32.13% on modest revenue expansion, driven by expanded EBITDA margins and a significant increase in other income. The company is strategically leveraging its vertically integrated model, expanding its global footprint (e.g., new US subsidiary, planned Europe 2027), and utilizing IPO proceeds to double manufacturing capacity, signaling strong future growth plans. A potential red flag is the substantial, unexplained surge in "Other Income" which may not be sustainable, along with lingering regulatory uncertainty surrounding long-term US tariff rates that could impact export margins in its largest market.
